answer.summary: Spring Boot 4 bump from a Renovate PR (pom.xml) left a Micrometer classpath mismatch. Every context-loading test fails with NoSuchMethodError on DefaultMeterObservationHandler.builder, so the app context never starts. This is deterministic and tied to the dependency change, so a rerun will fail the same way. The flaky-history data is not relevant here.

evidence.quote: Correct the classpath of your application so that it contains compatible versions of the classes org.springframework.boot.micrometer.metrics.autoconfigure.MetricsAutoConfiguration and io.micrometer.core.instrument.observation.DefaultMeterObservationHandler
